title: Lesson 2 Quiz: Blocks, Chains, and Consensus

questions.text: What is a hash in a blockchain and what happens if a block is altered?
options: A hash is a digital signature that changes if block data changes, instantly alerting the network.
A hash is a random number that remains the same regardless of changes to the block.
A hash is a transaction fee paid to miners for adding the block.
A hash is a user's private key used to sign the block.
questions.explanation: Each block receives a unique digital signature called a hash; changing even one figure in the block changes its signature instantly and alerts the network.

questions.text: True or false: Each block contains the signature (hash) of the previous block.
questions.explanation: Every new block contains the signature of the block before it, forming an unbroken chain.
